description.value: Empire Seafood Restaurant is a large-format Cantonese fine-dining destination in Richmond's London Plaza, established in 2004 and now seating over 300 guests in a lavishly decorated space near Richmond Centre SkyTrain. The restaurant is celebrated for dim sum, King Crab, and Peking Duck, and its award-winning dim sum chef draws on Pacific Ocean seafood and local BC produce. Beyond daily dining, it hosts weddings, corporate functions, and family banquets, making it one of the more prominent Chinese banquet halls in the Lower Mainland.
